title.narrative: Municipal Environmental Governance Project, Phase III (MEG 3)

description.narrative: The overarching goal of the project is to advance the democratization of local governance in Bosnia and Herzegovina, fostering more equitable, effective, and efficient public service delivery for citizens, with a particular focus on water supply and wastewater management services. By strengthening policy dialogue, regulatory frameworks, and governance reforms, the Project aims to enhance the sustainability, fairness, and effectiveness of essential local services.
